answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Complete the shape by adding two slanted sides that meet at a peak, so the figure becomes a house-like pentagon. Draw a line from the top-left corner of the shape (the top of the left vertical side) diagonally up and to the right, 3 units right and 3 units up, to a peak point directly above the middle of the bottom side (the peak is 3 units to the right of the top-left corner, and the middle of the 6-unit bottom side is 3 units from each end). Then draw a second line from that peak diagonally down and to the right, 3 units right and 3 units down, to the top of the right vertical side. The shape then has 5 sides: the bottom, the right vertical side, the right slanted side, the left slanted side, and the left vertical side. It has one line of symmetry, a vertical line through the peak and the middle of the bottom side.
